Kyoka Jiro, also known as the Hearing Hero: Earphone Jack, was a student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School, training to become a Hero.

Eight years after the Final War, Kyoka has graduated from U.A. High School alongside her classmates, and is currently the No. 30 Hero. She has also become a musician and Eri's mentor.

Kyoka is a petite, fair-skinned girl with a slender build. She has black, triangular eyes, with notably long lower eyelashes and small eyebrows. Her dark-purple hair is chin length, with an asymmetrical fringe that has two reflections shaped like sound waves on either side. She also has two chin length strands framing her face, and keeps the rest up to her neck. Her most prominent features are the flexible, plug-like earphone jacks hanging from each of her earlobes; they act like extra limbs that she is able to control at will, and change their length if so desired. Following the Paranormal Liberation War, she gains a small scar on her right earphone jack. During the Final War, most of her left ear and its entire earphone jack are blown off by All For One.

Afterwards, Kyoka wears a whitish-gray, shell-shaped prosthetic ear over her left, where an artificial earphone jack is dispensed from the bottom.

Unlike the other students, Kyoka sometimes wears a waistcoat over her school uniform, in place of the usual U.A. blazer.

Her hero costume consists of a black leather jacket, long salmon-colored shirt with several rips at the collar and hem, black pants, and boots with stereos built into their shafts. She also has two small, triangular red paint marks just below her eyes, a plain black choker, and white fingerless gloves.

Later on, her costume gains a set of headphones with two bracelets that double up as her amplifiers and she changes her face paint to two larger chevron-shaped marks.

Eight years after the Final War, Kyoka has grown taller, and the back part of her hair has grown out and now reaches her shoulders. Her updated hero costume now consists of a black sleeveless jacket over a white tank top, a new set of silver and purple headphones over her prosthetic left ear, and two mid-length black bands and salmon gloves for her Amplifier Jacks. She also wears black nail polish, and her boots now have two holes in the soles of them. The artificial jack on her left ear is now flesh-colored, with the front end separated by a shade of pink.

Kyoka has a pragmatic, unenthusiastic, blunt, and teasing personality that is mostly shown to those she finds irritating, like her fellow classmate Denki Kaminari, whose cluelessness makes him an easy target for her snarky comments. Kyoka is not always like this though, as she does enjoy socializing with others, in which case she is usually nice and friendly, most notably with Momo Yaoyorozu and the other girls in her class.

Kyoka often gesticulates through her elongated earlobes in place of her hands. She can also be quite aggressive, evidenced by when she uses the Earphone Jacks her Quirk provides, to physically punish people when provoked or to keep them in line, most notably Denki and Minoru Mineta. During hero activities, however, Kyoka prefers smarter approaches, usually by coming up with a plan herself. She is surprisingly organized and makes sure to convey her ideas in a way that's easy to understand.

Despite the fact that she comes off as cold and indifferent, Kyoka also has a much more sensitive side, being very defensive towards her friends, empathetic with others' feelings, and getting flustered when her talents and capabilities are brought up. While Kyoka is hard to unnerve or surprise, she is afraid of horror-based activities, and has an aversion to nudity. She is a bit self-conscious about her looks and style as well, becoming noticeably upset when she was not seen as attractive by Minoru, and attacking Denki and Yuga Aoyama for commenting that her dorm room was unladylike.

Like her parents, Kyoka has a major interest in rock music and owns several instruments which she is able to play to some extent. However, she seemed to be somewhat embarrassed about her interests at first, because she perceived them as completely unrelated to heroism, but thanks to a great presentation during the U.A. School Festival, she was able to outgrow that mindset.

Overall Abilities: While she doesn't commonly employ close-quarters combat efficiency, Kyoka makes effective use of the handling she has on her Quirk, Earphone Jack. She utilizes the prehensile nature of her Earphone Jack Quirk in whip-like fashion, and use the sound generating effects of her Quirk to shock targets with vibrations, effectively stunning and sometimes defeating them. By the time of the Provisional Hero License Exam, Kyoka improved the efficacy of her Quirk, allowing her to plug her earphone jacks into the ground, and generate sound waves strong enough to make the ground quake, cause fissures, and disrupt large enemy formations. Her abilities eventually garnered the attention of Gang Orca, giving Kyoka the opportunity to intern under the No. 12 (formerly No. 10) Pro Hero, and improve on her search techniques. On Nabu Island, Kyoka, alongside Mashirao Ojiro, acted as the fourth line of defense against Nine, and effectively ambushed him before he subdued the two with his Hydra Quirk. Soon after, Mashirao and Kyoka aided Mezo Shoji against the powerful foe, forcing Nine into using the full power of his Air Wall Quirk to defeat the trio of students.

Keen Intellect: Despite her unenthusiastic demeanor, Kyoka is quite intelligent, scoring 7th place in the midterms, displaying her skill in academics. She is also quite strategic, as she took advantage of the volatile nature of Denki's Quirk to allow the Stun Gun Hero to electrocute multiple villains during the U.S.J. Incident.

Indomitable Will: In a rare sense of moment, Kyoka displays remarkable willpower. Though not as strong as All For One, Tomura, or Izuku, she managed to shrug off her fear after feeling the overwhelming power of All For One during the Final War. Her spirit was strong enough to stir up resistance from within All For One's vestige world, causing some of the former users of the Quirks he has stolen to rebel against him, although All For One also surmised that this was due to him using a duplicate of his Quirk rather than the original.

Musical Talent: Kyoka is able to play the bass, which is her preferred instrument alongside the guitar. She can play other instruments as well, like drums, but only to a limited extent. Her singing voice is described as "husky, but heavenly".

Earphone Jack: Kyoka's Quirk is that she has a pair of headphone jacks hanging from her earlobes. When the jacks are plugged into something, Kyoka can channel the sound of her heartbeat through them in the form of a violent vibration attack. She can stretch her earlobes several meters. This Quirk also allows her to hear minuscule sounds and vibrations from her surroundings.

As part of her training, Kyoka honed her headphone jacks by repeatedly piercing them into a stone cliff, all to increase the amount of audio she can hear with her Quirk.

Counter-Balance: Plugging her jacks on the legs of her hero costume, Kyoka sends out a powerful soundwave from the amplifiers on her legs that cancels other sound-based attacks.

Heartbeat Distortion: Plugging her jacks on the special sound amplifiers on her forearms, Kyoka slams the amplifiers onto the floor and channels a powerful soundwave, shattering the ground due to the vibrations.

Heartbeat Surround: Plugging her jacks on the special sound amplifiers on her forearms, Kyoka uses her elongated earlobes to remove the amplifiers from her wrists and direct them towards her target at close range, releasing a powerful, short-range soundwave to incapacitate them.

Legato: Kyoka performs her Heartbeat Surround move on a larger scale, with more power, and with more sound generated.

Heartbeat Wall: Similar to Heartbeat Surround, Kyoka once again plugs her jacks on her forearm amplifiers and uses her earlobes to remove them and aim them towards a target, but instead channels her heartbeat to form a sound wall that blocks and impedes her enemies' movement.

Amplifier Jack: Devices that Kyoka can plug her jacks into, amplifying even further the sound and vibration of her heartbeat. They are worn on both of her forearms.

Stereo Boots: A pair of boots that Kyoka can plug her earphone jacks into. They amplify her heartbeat and can direct the vibrations in a certain direction. She can even direct the vibrations through her feet to propel herself into the air.

Headphones: A device that presumably compliments her jacks' ability to pick up sound vibrations.

Prosthetic Ear: A device that serves as a replacement for Kyoka's missing left ear and earphone jack, presumably replicating an artificial version of her earlobe to complement her Quirk. It possesses the ability to extend and retract like her original earphone jack.

(To Koji about using his Quirk to combat Present Mic) "If you do this, we just might win. But there's no time to hesitate, so do it now! You wanna be a hero, don't you?! Then let's pass this test."

(To her classmates, agreeing to host a live show for the U.A. School Festival) "Turning down... all these requests... wouldn't make me much of a rock star!"

Kyoka has an excellent relationship with her parents. They were the ones who taught her music at an early age, and thanks to them, Kyoka has found her way around a couple of instruments.

When she was young, Kyoka felt pressured into wanting to be a hero since her parents wanted her to become a musician and felt guilty when she finally revealed this to them one day. Kyotoku and Mika were very understanding and received this welcomingly, supporting Kyoka's dream that even continues to this day after the incident where Kyoka was affected by Mustard's knockout gas during the Vanguard Action Squad Invasion event.

Denki and Kyoka are good friends and are frequently shown interacting with each other. The two heroes-in-training were paired together very early in the school year: first during the Battle Trial, and later at the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. Kyoka is very helpful to Denki at the U.S.J., helping him to have more self-confidence about using his Quirk. As Denki thinks that he can't use his Quirk with Kyoka and Momo around, he is not able to use it well, but when forced to by Kyoka, he finally realized that he too can fight and be helpful.

Kyoka happens to enjoy Denki's brainless state and finds humor in as well her frequently teasing the boy, with the main source of it being his behavior and low intelligence. Although he generally hates those remarks, Denki never holds any lasting contempt for them, likely since he recognizes it as just playful ribbing most of time. Denki also isn't exempt from pushing Kyoka's buttons on occassion, though it's typically a result of him being obtuse rather than an attempt at personal amusement, such as when he called her dorm room "unlady-like".

When Denki finds out about her insecurities around her music hobby, he compliments her, encouraging her to embrace her hobbies publicly, Kyoka gets flustered by his praise but is eventually convinced to make use of it for their School Festival performance.

During the preview at I-Expo, Kyoka was surprised to see him at I-Island working as a waiter along with Minoru, which they took up for the free trip to the island (and potentially score romantic encounters with girls in Minoru's case). When Kyoka showed up in a fancy dress for the reception, Denki and Minoru proceeded to comment on her appearance. This ended up causing her to plug her Earphone Jacks onto them. As Denki protests and claims that he was "complimenting" her, Kyoka responds by telling Denki that he wasn't complimenting her at all. When Wolfram and his gang was invading the Island, Denki said that they should just sit and wait until the villains are done. Kyoka got up and ask if Denki was okay with that. Denki responded of what choice they had. Kyoka later asked if they should at least try to stop them.

The two were seen next to each other hiding when the other members of Wolfram's gang went searching for them. When the group go to the 130th Floor, they saw I-Island Security Bots, they later realized that they are trying to capture them. After Momo made an Insulator Sheet with her Quirk. Denki used an Indiscriminate Shock 1.3 Million Volts on the Security Drones, but it had no effect. Denki later went to 2 Million Volts, realizing what he was about to do. Kyoka told him not to as he would short-circuit faster, which he did.

Later when the 138th floor when faced with the Security Drones and Tenya let Denki down from his back, Kyoka was seen holding him. When the Security system was reset, the two along with Tenya and Momo were freed. When Wolfram used the Quirk Amplification Device, she and the others regrouped with the others. She and Ochaco were seen holding Denki while he was still in his mindless state. She was later seen holding him as the fight with Izuku and All Might with Wolfram, she cheered them on as she was still holding him.

When Nine and his group were invading Nabu Island hunting for Katsuma Shimano's Cell Activation Quirk. The two helped with reinforcements and helping with their classmates with the fight with Hoyo Makihara, after the fight Kyoka asked if they were fine. After Nine retreated, Kyoka holding emergency supplies looked as Denki and Momo were over using their Quirks to supply the people what they needed. Denki started to short-circuit as his brain was starting to fry. When Class 1-A were reflecting on the villains they fought, Kyoka told the class that Denki and Momo used up too much of their power already.

When Denki begins to panic and fear for his life during the raid on the Gunga Mountain Villa, Midnight tells him to think of the person who matters most to him, and Denki's focus centers on Kyoka, who encourages him and tells him to stay strong. At this point Kyoka seems to be one of Denki's closest friends, and it's likely that Kyoka knows Denki thought about her following Midnight's advice because, as her earphone jacks were plugged into the ground, she spoke up right when Denki looked back at her.

After graduating and becoming Pro Heroes, Denki and Kyoka station their Hero Agencies right next to each other. When Class 1-A reunites to celebrate Shoto becoming the No. 2 Hero, Toru brings up that Shihai and Kinoko from Class 1-B started dating recently, which prompts Hanta to ask about the other two about any hidden depths in their relationship. Kyoka laughs it off as a misunderstanding, with Denki clarifying that he just got lucky in getting an office that happened to be right next to hers.

Momo and Kyoka are close friends, that get along quite well with each other. Along with Denki, the two battled against the League of Villains at the U.S.J., proving that they work well together. After that, they are often seen spending time with one another, both in and out of class. Kyoka was on the of the students who asked Momo to tutor her for the end of term test, which she accepted. After the exams, when the class splits up to go shopping for the training camp, they pair up and go off shopping together.

Kyoka also was shown early on to be fairly defensive of Momo, with most instances coincidentally being related to how she uses her Quirk. When the other girl has to expose herself to make large objects, such as during the U.S.J. Incident, and their fight in the Provisional License Exam, Kyoka is always quick to shield and protect her friend's decency from any potentially prying eyes, even if she's personally embarrassed by it herself. During the summer training camp, she punches Hanta for comparing Momo's Quirk's ability to convert fat at an atomic level into many different objects, to defecation.

Despite their vastly different demeanors and upbringings, both have picked up certain tastes from each other. For example, Momo started listening to heavy metal music after being introduced to it by Kyoka. Likewise, Kyoka started regularly drinking tea and listening to classical music after spending time with Momo.

Momo later joins Kyoka's band, playing the keyboard, during the School Festival and they pull off a wonderful performance with the teamwork of all of Class 1-A. They're also shown enjoying some of the other events after their show ended.

Before Wolfram and his gang took control of I-Island, Ochaco, Momo, and Kyoka came late before meeting everyone. When Momo and Kyoka meet up with their group, Kyoka was seen hiding behind Momo, as she was feeling shy. When Wolfram invaded the Island, at the on 138th floor the server room when facing against the I-Island Security Bots Momo created a cannon for Kyoka to use against the bots while Momo created soft ammo for Kyoka to use. When Momo overused her Quirk, the two were tied together by the security bots. During the fight with Wolfram they both cheered for Izuku and All Might when they were about to defeat Wolfram.

When Nine invaded Nabu Island on the search for Katsuma's Cell Activation Quirk. The two were paired up to together as reinforcements and to aid their inquired classmates. After Nine and his gang retreated, both Momo and Denki were helping with emergency supplies. Kyoka watched as both her and Denki were overusing their Quirks.

They are on good terms as they are often seen talking, such as in the Vs. Hero Killer Arc when they discussed their internships. Both also teased Ochaco about her crush on Izuku. Mina is also often seen chatting with Kyoka in the background with some other classmates too.

Kyoka comforted Mina when it was discovered that Yuga Aoyama was the traitor.

Even though both haven't directly interacted one-on-one, Eijiro and Kyoka are occasionally seen talking with each other in the background with other classmates such as Mina and Hanta, and seem to get along fine. Eijiro also asked Kyoka to sing when others were also asking and was soon blown away by her talent like the rest of his classmates.

Kyoka is partnered with Koji during the Final Exams Arc against Present Mic. Although Koji is very shy and terrified of insects, Kyoka's words and example of bravery convince him to use his Quirk to talk to bugs of the forest, while she is annoyed that he picked that late of a moment to talk and help him. Nevertheless, Koji later carries an injured Kyoka through the forest to cross the escape gate, and together they pass the exam.

During the festival, Koji encourages Kyoka to play giving her more confidence. Overall, the two appear to be on good terms.

Like all the other girls, Toru and Kyoka get along well and are often seen talking together. During the U.A. Sports Festival, she is put off by Toru's desire to act as a cheerleader after they're tricked by Denki and Minoru Mineta. She is also partnered up with Toru in the 'Test of Courage' during the Quirk Training Camp.

Toru is also thankful for Kyoka halting Minoru's attempted peeping in the locker room. The two along with Mina tried to coax Ochaco into telling who her crush was the night after they finished training their Ultimate Moves.

While their interactions aren't very frequent, Kyoka and Sero seem to be on good terms and get along well. Kyoka also punched Hanta after likening Momo's Quirk to defecation during their Quirk Training Camp. Another scene they shared was when Kyoka complimented Hanta for his unexpected dorm room design.

The two were also on the same team in the Joint Training Battle, alongside Katsuki and Rikido, with Hanta assisting her in taking out their opponents. Hanta also gifted her a scarf with a unique, Asian flare for Kyoka during the surprise exchange gift moment on Christmas Eve.

Though the two haven't interacted on a one-on-one conversation, the two are usually seen chatting with their classmates. Kyoka and Fumikage also cooperated during the School Festival, whereas he was one of the members who played the guitar for the band. Kyoka was also seen lending him her notes for him to use as guidance.

Kyoka was also shown to be concerned for him during the Paranormal Liberation War when both Fumikage and Denki went ahead in the front lines.

Despite not having too much interaction with each other, Izuku and Kyoka mutually respect and care for one another as classmates.

During the Vs. Hero Killer Arc, Kyoka initially wonders how Izuku will do in the Rescue Training Race and is amazed by Izuku overcoming the drawbacks of his Quirk. Kyoka also finds Izuku's notebook very interesting and impressive, where Izuku notes his classmates' abilities. Izuku has also occasionally complimented Kyoka's Quirk for its pinpoint accuracy and stealth attributes.

Sometimes, she gets curious of Izuku every now and then, as she notices him with Melissa Shield, claiming that she had used her Quirk and heard everything, much to his shock.

During the School Festival Arc, a flashback of Kyoka and Izuku is shown in which Kyoka asks Izuku for help on taking and revising her notes for the band. They share a friendly moment with each other in which he is impressed with her initial note taking and proceeds to help her leading up to the School Festival. They seem to be on friendly terms from this point on with Izuku using her memory as one of many to push on in his fight with Gentle Criminal in order to prevent him from cancelling the event and to make it back in time to help in her performance. During his struggles with Blackwhip, Kyoka is shown to be visibly worried for him.

After the resulting battle with Tomura Shigaraki she shows up outside of his hospital room asking Ochaco if he's woken up yet.

During the battle between Class 1-A and Izuku, Kyoka tells Izuku she is very happy that he not only helped her with how to organize notes during the Culture Festival, but also sharing a hobby of note-taking. She also commented on how Izuku got stronger.

Kyoka was willing to support Izuku, and cares for him enough that when thinking of All For One making Izuku suffer because he has One For All makes her angry, and would dare to attack anyone who would harm her friends.

Like all the girls in 1-A, Kyoka despises Minoru's perverted and lecherous attitude towards them and is seen either chastising or punishing him with her Quirk on a few occasions. During the U.A. Sports Festival Arc, she wakes up from a nap and stabs Minoru with her jacks, while chewing him out for encouraging Yuga to burn Mina's gym clothes off during their tournament match. Later on, Kyoka becomes frustrated and angry at both Minoru and Denki after the two boys had tricked the girls in Class 1-A to dress in revealing cheerleader outfits.

In the girls locker room, shortly after a training session had concluded, Kyoka used her Quirk and overheard Minoru's attempt to peek at the girls through a secret peephole in the locker rooms. Kyoka prevented this by stabbing Minoru right in his eye with one of her Earphone cables. Minoru's words appeared to have hit a sore point for Kyoka however, as she wondered why she wasn't mentioned along with the other girls while Minoru was fawning over them. In fact, most likely as a result of her less feminine personality and body type, Kyoka is least targeted girl in her class in regard to Minoru's harassment.

Despite her skepticism and disliking of Minoru, she still seems to accept him as a fellow classmate. In My Hero Academia: Two Heroes, she didn't seem to have any problem with him and Denki receiving special invite tickets to the I-Island Expo, courtesy of Melissa Shield, and even seemed happy about it. Although she did stab him and Denki with her cables after the two commented on her dress after turning up to the event. Whilst Minoru and Denki were both enamored by Melissa's dress upon the girl's arrival, she only sheepishly grinned at the two. When the group suggested for Minoru to climb on the outside of the hijacked I-Island Central Tower in order to open up a vent, Kyoka was one of the first to encourage him to go through with it, emphasizing the fact that he's the only one capable of it.

They are often seen interacting and talking with each other in the background alongside some other classmates at times such as Toru or Fumikage. They have also shown splendid teamwork during their ambush against Nine on Nabu Island. Kyoka was also seen shouting out Mashirao's name in concern when he was taken out by Nine.

Katsuki and Kyoka's interactions at the start of the series have been minimal. They were first seen sitting next to each other on the bus when Kyoka looks annoyed and freaked out by Katsuki's loud angry outbursts at Denki.

Starting from the School Festival Arc is when these two begin to develop a tolerance for one another and a fledgling friendship. Kyoka asks Katsuki to help her in the Festival by playing guitar, he berates her and tells her he has no time for that. They are then seen working together and preparing for their performance with the other members of the band.

They are later paired up on the same team during the Class 1-A vs Class 1-B trials. Kyoka and Katsuki come to understand each other and put trust into one another. Katsuki, who always works solo, puts trust into his teammates and relies on Kyoka to scout out and listen for their opponents. Katsuki later comes to her aid when she was cornered by the opposing team in the Joint Training Battle. She is grateful for this and they along with the rest of their team went on to overpower their foes, achieving a complete victory.

Initially, Kyoka and Ochaco have very little interaction with each other; as the story progresses, the two build up a friendship, and are on good terms. The two are seen hanging out occasionally outside of class, usually with the other girls of Class 1-A, talking about various things. The night after training for their Ultimate Moves, both Mina, Toru and Kyoka tried to find out who Ochaco's crush, and Kyoka said that they wouldn't give up until they found out who it was. Before the U.A. School Festival Ochaco compliments Kyoka for her musical skills, recalling occasions where the latter would practice while Ochaco and Toru would watch.

When Ochaco, Momo, and Kyoka explain why they were invited to I-Island, Kyoka casually rests her arm on Ochaco's shoulder, telling Melissa that they were selected by Momo as two guests.

The two have not interacted much, but they were teamed up with each other during the Calvary Battle at the Sports Festival, and fought on the same team during the Joint Training. When the students were moved into the Heights Alliance, during the competition with the dorm rooms, at Rikido's room all girls except Tsuyu were enjoying the cake that Rikido baked.

While they aren't seen interacting often, Kyoka and Yuga appear to get on as fellow classmates. Although during the best room competition, when Yuga commented that her room was unladylike, she punished him alongside Denki by jabbing them both with her earphone cables.

Like the rest of her classmates, Kyoka was deeply shocked and distressed to learn that Yuga was an unwilling mole for All For One who was responsible for the U.S.J. Incident and the Vanguard Action Squad Invasion. After learning the whole story however, Kyoka gains the desire to forgive Yuga and help him redeem himself by taking down All For One together.

While fighting All For One, Kyoka expresses her outrage that he was the one responsible for making her friends Izuku and Yuga cry, showing that she still considers Yuga as one of her friends despite everything that happened.

All For One came across Kyoka during the battle over the Gunga Villa ruins when Endeavor and Hawks had tried to take him on away from the other heroes in a more concentrated attack strategy. Following his successful provocation of Endeavor's anger leading to him taking a chunk out of his side, Kyoka swooped in on Fumikage's back to push Hawks out of harm's way. All For One described the two students as merely "jobber characters", but Kyoka defiantly told him to save it until after he had actually managed to beat them.

All For One continued to mock Kyoka, calling her a deluded extra as he focused on attacking her as a weak spot with full intent to kill her. Kyoka bravely stood her ground, but was nevertheless terrified at All For One's sheer malice as he volleyed several deadly attacks that just barely missed her, with one managing to tear her ear off. Despite the pain, Kyoka retorted that she had to face All For One for putting her friends Izuku and Yuga through so much distress before firing off her new ultimate move, Heartbeat Surround Legato.

All For One took the attack head on and dismissed it as weak as he prepared to counterattack, gleeful at the thought of getting to kill another child. His arrogance was stopped short by the Quirk vestiges inside the weaker copy of his Quirk rebelling against him in response to Legato. Inspired by Kyoka's bravery, they held All For One back long enough for Hawks to finally shatter his mask, subsequently leading to Endeavor finally burning him to a crisp.

Kyoka's efforts had proven instrumental in pushing All For One to the brink and making him trigger his last fail-safe by using a copy of Rewind to regenerate to full strength. While restored to his prime, he had also signed his death warrant and acknowledged that Rewind would eventually vanish him out of existence.

Kyoka Jiro was born to Kyotoku and Mika Jiro, a couple of a composer and a musician. She inherited her mother's Quirk, Earphone Jack. At a young age, thanks to the influence of her parents, Kyoka developed an interest in music, eventually learning to play several instruments.

Despite her parents desires for her to become a musician, she decided to become a hero instead because she wanted to dedicate her work to others. When she told her parents about her plans, they were happy for her and let her walk her own path.

Kyoka participates in the Quirk Apprehension Test taught by Shota Aizawa, doing her best after the teacher threatened to expel the student who got the worst marks. In the end she Ranked 17th in the test, so in theory she is spared from being expelled, although like most students she is surprised when Shota reveals that the expulsion was a lie, a rational deception to force them to draw out their limits.

During the Battle Trial exercise, she is teamed with Denki Kaminari as "Team G" after being randomly drawn, participating as the Hero team. They face Team C, made up of Momo Yaoyorozu and Mineta, who act as villains in the exercise.

During the battle, Kyoka uses her Earphone Jack to locate the rival team, indicating it to Denki, who advances with his Quirk ready to be used. It is unknown how well they both did in the trial itself.

Shota announces to the Class 1-A that they will partake in rescue training at an outside facility. Once they arrive at the Unforeseen Simulation Joint, where they meet the Space Hero: Thirteen. Thirteen explains she developed the U.S.J. with the focus on training future heroes on using their Quirks to help others. Suddenly during Thirteen's speech, The League of Villains invade the facility through a warp gate.

Shota fends off the villains on his own and leaves Thirteen to evacuate with the class. They prepare to escape, but they are cut off by the villain Kurogiri. Katsuki and Eijiro attack him, but end up dealing no damage. Kurogiri responds by warping the class to the various areas in the facility. Kyoka is warped to the mountain area of the Unforeseen Simulation Joint along with Momo Yaoyorozu and Denki, being ambushed by villains.

Using her Creation Quirk, Momo creates weapons for herself and Kyoka to defend themselves while Denki has to avoid the enemies' attacks. He begs for a weapon, but Kyoka tells him to use his Electrification Quirk. Denki replies he can surround his body with electricity, but if he shoots it out he risks friendly fire. If he releases it, it will spread out across the area and risk hitting the girls. He also warns that he can't call for help as someone is jamming the signal, so they can't count on him.

A villain attacks Denki, but he ducks. Annoyed that Denki is complaining too much, she kicks him into one of the villains and labelled him a "Human Stun Gun". When he collides with the villain, Denki electrifies him with his Quirk. Denki gains a confidence boost when he realizes he can defeat the villains without endangering his classmates, and Kyoka comments, he's too happy-go-lucky. She then uses her Quirk to protect Denki from an attack by one of the villains.

Kyoka plugs her jacks into her boots to launch a sonic attack, causing the villains to block their ears in pain, which gives Momo the time needed to create an insulator sheet. Kyoka and Momo hide under the insulator sheet while Denki discharges a great amount of electricity, defeating the villains while Kyoka and Momo remain unharmed.

However, one of the villains takes the air-headed Denki hostage, forcing Kyoka and Momo to stop fighting back and remain motionless. Kyoka attempts a sneak attack by distracting the villain through conversation, but fails. Fortunately, the villain holding Denki is shot down by Snipe, freeing Denki, with Kyoka rushing to tie up the villain. She is then seen with her class after the battle with the League of Villains is over.

After Shota Aizawa announces that the U.A. Sports Festival is approaching, Denki says that he plans to become a Pro's sidekick after he graduates, to which Kyoka states that many people become sidekicks and fail to become real Heroes, to which she thinks that Denki is the kind of person who would become like that, which causes Denki to become crestfallen. Kyoka competes in the Obstacle Race where she places twenty-first, allowing her to compete in the Cavalry Battle.

In the Human Cavalry Battle, she teams up with Rikido Sato, Koji Koda, and Toru Hagakure while Toru is the rider. When the Human Cavalry Battle begins, Kyoka uses her Quirk to try and grab Izuku Midoriya's headband due to Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu's stating it's just a big battle for it, but Fumikage uses his Dark Shadow to block her attack. Later in the Human Cavalry Battle, her team charges towards Shoto Todoroki's team, but her team gets zapped by Denki and frozen by Shoto's team. Her team fails to qualify to the next round when her team lost the Human Cavalry Battle.

After Denki and Minoru Mineta states that the girls must do the cheering battle as per orders from their homeroom teacher, Kyoka and the other girls of Class 1-A walk out in cheer leading outfits. However, as Kyoka and the girls walk out, they realize they have been tricked. Kyoka then calls Denki and Minoru idiots. During the recreational events, Kyoka is seen sitting still in her cheerleader outfit while watching Mina Ashido, Ochaco Uraraka, Tsuyu Asui, and Toru cheer-lead.

As the match between Ochaco and Katsuki begins, Kyoka comments that she might look away the entire time. During the match between Ochaco and Katsuki, Kyoka averts her eyes from the match when seeing Katsuki's explosion assault on Ochaco. Kyoka along with her class watches the closing ceremony of U.A.'s Sports Festival.

Two days after the Sports Festival, Kyoka is in class. During the Hero Informatics period, Class 1-A has to decide on Hero names. Kyoka gives Denki an idea for his Hero name: Jamming Way, causing Denki to reply that her idea was good, as it references the intellectual: Hemingway. But Kyoka revealed she was just using that name as a means to make fun of Denki, leaving him disappointed. Kyoka writes down and shows her Hero name to her classmates. Kyoka reveals her Hero name to be Earphone Jack, the Hearing Hero.

After Class 1-A has finished formulating their hero names, Kyoka is given a list of 40 workplaces in order to choose a workplace that she would like to train at. On the day of the workplace training, Kyoka is at the train station with her class so that she can go to the workplace of her choice by train.

Kyoka chose Death Arms for her Hero Agency Internships. Death Arms works out Kyoka hard in the field. He makes her run during patrol and she barely keeps up with him. Kyoka thinks to herself about much harder her training is compared to school. Later, Kyoka helps Death Arms rescue civilians from a hostage situation. She uses her Quirk to figure out how many hostages were taken. Kyoka escorts them both to safety after Death Arms rushes in.

The workplace training comes to an end and Kyoka returns to U.A. After Foundational Hero Studies is finished, Kyoka catches up with Tsuyu and Mina and she is amazed by Tsuyu's activities. She is among the students bearing witness to the gamma race, where she and Momo count Izuku out since his Quirk has repercussions. They are quickly proven wrong when Izuku shows off his new moves and they are surprised as well as amazed at his better control of his Quirk and lead in the race until he trips causing him to lose.

Later on, Kyoka is in the girls' locker room where she uses her earphone jacks to hear Minoru's plan to peek on the girls, making the list of things he wants to see from each one but without mentioning Kyoka. She plugs one of her earphone jacks into the hole which stabs Minoru's eye, stopping Minoru from peeking. Though thanked by the other girls, an embarrassed and insecure Kyoka wonders why she was the only one he did not mention.

One week before the end of term test, Kyoka asks Momo to help her study. Throughout the final week before the end of term test, Kyoka studies under Momo's tutoring along with Denki, Mina, Mashirao and Hanta. On the day of the exercise test, Mr. Principal reveals that Class 1-A will be fighting against U.A.'s teachers for their First Term Final Exam. Kyoka is paired with Koji and they must face Present Mic in their exam.

Koji, Kyoka and Present Mic arrive in an uninhabited city where Class 1-A's test exercise will take place. In the city, Kyoka mocks Present Mic for what she takes as a poor reference, to which Present Mic tells her to be careful with what she says. Present Mic explains the 30-minute test; Kyoka and Koji must either handcuff him or one of them must escape the battlefield within 30 minutes in order to win and pass the test. The test begins.

Kyoka plugs in her Earphone Jacks to try and block out Present Mic's loud voice, but to no avail. Annoyed by Present Mic's loud voice, Kyoka tells Koji to command the nearby animals to attack but Koji is unable to due to Present Mic's voice making the animals wild and as a result, any command he gave would be useless.

Kyoka and Koji manage to get a little closer to the escape gate, but Kyoka notes that Present Mic will be at the escape gate and that no matter what option of victory they choose, a standoff is inevitable. Present Mic uses his loud voice again; Kyoka notes that they cannot get any closer as long as Present Mic is using his Quirk. Kyoka sees an ant and comes up with an idea; she asks Koji if he can control bugs but his terrified reaction indicates that he doesn't like bugs. Present Mic uses his loud voice once again; Kyoka tries to counteract with her Earphone Jacks and use Counter-Balance on Present Mic's voice.

Present Mic continues using his loud voice against Kyoka and Koji who are unable to handle it. Out of options, Kyoka asks Koji if he can control insects to which he approves. Kyoka uses her Earphone Jacks to break a rock which reveals dozens of insects, much to Koji's terror. Kyoka tells Koji that she understands his phobia but using the insects to attack Present Mic is the only plan she can think of because their opponent is too strong. Kyoka encourages Koji to follow through with her plan.

After seeing Kyoka's bleeding ears, Koji is ashamed that he is running away from this fight and realizes that he can only continue being at U.A. by overcoming his fear. Koji musters up the courage and commands the insects to attack Present Mic while Kyoka is annoyed he picked that moment to talk. At the escape gate, Present Mic sees that time is nearly up.

Suddenly, dozens of insects crawl on Present Mic, who realizes that the insects traveled to him by moving underground; a place where sound is ineffective. Present Mic is paralyzed by fear, allowing Koji to run through the escape gate while carrying an injured Kyoka with him; thus they pass the practical test.

Back at U.A. in class, Kyoka learns that she has passed the written test and will go along with her classmates to the forest lodge which is a boot camp. Kyoka accompanies her class to the Kiyashi Ward Shopping Mall to buy necessities for the forest lodge. At the shopping mall, Kyoka says that she requires a big carrying bag, to which Momo tells Kyoka that she will help her look for it.

After Momo was invited to I-Expo she had a few extra invitations, so her, Kyoka, Tsuyu, Mina, and Toru played Rock, Paper, Scissors to see who would go to the preview of I-Expo. Both her and Ochaco won their chance to see the preview.

While looking around the expo, she, Momo, and Ochaco see Izuku talking with Melissa Shield, and suspect that they are on a date. Izuku clears up the misunderstanding and says that Melissa is showing him around the expo. The five go get tea at a café, and are surprised to see Denki Kaminari and Minoru Mineta, who are working as extra staff at the cafe. They soon meet Tenya, who is representing his family, reprimanding Denki and Minoru for slacking off.

They notice an explosion nearby, and the group finds out about the Villain Attack attraction, where they see Eijiro and Katsuki. Katsuki notices Izuku and is irritated, making a scene in front of the audience. Melissa watches in amazement at the young heroes around her, while Kyoka, Momo, and Ochaco express embarrassment at Katsuki's crude behavior.

Melissa invites the students to attend the reception party at 6:30 PM, and Momo helps choose formal clothes for Kyoka and Ochaco. The students are stunned at their formal clothes, embarrassing Kyoka and Ochaco. Denki and Minoru make inappropriate comments about how she is dressed, so Kyoka punishes them by using her Quirk on them. When Melissa arrives wearing a dress, Kyoka comments badly about Denki and Mineta's over-the-top cheerful reactions.

However, the I-Island Security System sets off an alarm across the whole island, locking the central tower from the outside. Because their cell phones have no signal and the elevators are disabled, Izuku tells everyone to head over to the party because that's where All Might is.

With the help of Kyoka's Earphone Jack Quirk, they learn that the villain Wolfram has the island held hostage. Tenya suggests that the students escape since they can't legally fight villains, but Melissa reveals that I-Island's security is on par with Tartarus'. Shoto and Kyoka believe that they should try to help while Minoru and Momo believe they can't. Awkward silence is interrupted when Izuku says he wants to save everyone. After discussing among themselves, everyone agrees to try to help the heroes by disabling the security system.

They scale over fifty floors before being blocked by a closed shutter on the 80th floor. Minoru accidentally opens the door to the main section of the floor, notifying the villains. Before the shutters could close them off from both ends, Tenya and Shoto make an opening and lead the group into the plant factory. Kyoka notices the elevator coming up, so they hide. The villains in the elevator notice and attack Katsuki and Eijiro, who were lost. Shoto saves them and lifts the rest of the group up using an ice pillar.

The group find a small roof panel that leads to the maintenance room, and convince Minoru to complete the job. He succeeds, and the group advances past the 100th floor. They notice that the shutters are closed and deduce that the villains are trying to lead them somewhere, which turns out to be a swarm of security bots on the 130th floor. Denki attacks first with his Indiscriminate Shock 1.3 Million Volts, it turns out ineffective against the robots, so they resort to using Momo's smoke bombs. Izuku and Tenya use their power to break through the robot blockade. Tenya rescues the short-circuited Denki while Kyoka listens for more robots.

In the server room on the 138th floor, the group agrees to stay back and fight the incoming security bots while Izuku, Melissa, and Ochaco continue up. Tenya uses his Recipro Burst and Momo creates a cannon that fires adhesive material. However, Tenya, Minoru, and Momo pushed themselves to their limits, so they are restrained by the robots.

They are set free when Melissa overrode the security system, and they head to the top of the tower. There, they encourage All Might and Izuku as they fight Wolfram, and cheered after his defeat. Kyoka is later seen hanging out with her classmates at a barbeque party.

Due to a shopping center incident, where Izuku had an encounter with Tomura Shigaraki, Shota informs Class 1-A that the destination for their lodge trip has been changed and the new destination will only be announced on the day of the event. The first semester has come to a close and summer break has begun.

On the day of the summer camp, they are informed that the new destination will be a mountainous region, owned by the professional Hero Team, the Wild, Wild Pussycats, where they will undergo reinforcement training to strengthen and upgrade their Quirks which will also allow Class 1-A to obtain their temporary licenses. Class 1-A's bus stops for a restroom break, where they meet Pixie-Bob and Mandalay, who challenge the students to reach base camp past the forest in three hours. Then, all Class 1-A is forcibly thrown into The Beast's Forest by Pixie-Bob's Quirk.

To reach their destination, they must traverse the forest, which is inhabited by dozens of hostile earth monsters created by Pixie-Bob. The students work together to fight their way through the forest. To help her classmates, Kyoka, along with Mezo Shoji, use her Quirk to detect the location of the approaching beasts.

The journey through the forest to the Cabin takes them around eight hours before finally arrive at the facility, battered and tired. Class 1-A fetch their luggage from the bus and put it in their rooms, and later go to the dining hall and the Pussycats serve dinner.

The next morning, Class 1-A are outside the training camp cabin. Shota greets his students and tells them that they will undergo reinforcement training to strengthen and upgrade their Quirks. She trains to increase the quality of sound from her Quirk by strengthening her Earphone Jack by constantly hitting a rock with the jacks of her earlobes. Afterward, Class 1-A and 1-B are tasked with cooking for themselves. During dinner, Kyoka punches Hanta and makes him apologize for making a very rude comment about Momo's Quirk, saying that her ability to create things from her body after eating is like pooping.

During the third day of the lodge trip, while Classes 1-A and 1-B are undergoing their Quirk-strengthening training, Pixie-Bob announces both classes that tonight they will be playing a game, a test of courage. Kyoka did not like the idea because she hates scary things. Later, that night, Kyoka is paired with Toru, being the third pair to enter the forest where the test takes place.

At that moment, the Vanguard Action Squad attacks the training camp, filling the forest with poisonous gas. Kyoka and Toru are unconscious because of the gas, being later found by Momo and Yuga Aoyama. Momo had created several gas masks, and placed two on the faces of her classmates to protect them. After this, Momo asks Yuga to take the unconscious Kyoka and Toru back to the facility while she leaves to help, while she looks for the students of class 1-B.

Kyoka and Toru are hospitalized because of the gas, and did not know that the Vanguard Action Squad members managed to kidnap Katsuki.

After Katsuki is captured by the Vanguard Action Squad, Kyoka is taken to hospital in the hopes that she regains consciousness. Eventually, Kyoka regains consciousness, recovers and returns home. Shota and All Might visit her house and speak to her parents regarding relocating the U.A. students to the dormitories.

Kyoka's father is initially hesitant, but Kyoka tells Shota not to worry since her father has already agreed to send her to the dorms since he is actually happy that her daughter will become a powerful hero like All Might after witnessing his fight on TV. Her father and herself began bickering till Kyoka's mother told them to stop.

Due to the attack of the villains, and after Katsuki's rescue and All Might retirement, As a security measure, Nezu decides to build the Heights Alliance, a group of buildings inside the campus, where the students reside. The Height Alliance was built in just three days. It is meant to protect the students and allows the teachers to keep close surveillance on the students.

Shota Aizawa meets with his students outside of the building. He states they must start preparing to get Provisional Hero Licenses like they had planned to during the training camp. Before they can enter, Shota reads the riot act against Izuku, Tenya Ida, Momo, Eijiro Kirishima, and Shoto for participating in the Katsuki's rescue, breaking the rules in the process, and the others who did nothing to stop them from doing it through the proper channels, stating that aside from Katsuki, Toru and Kyoka (the first for being kidnapped and the other two for being unconscious in the hospital when everything happened) he would have expelled all of them for their actions, if it weren't for All Might's sudden retirement. After this, he allowed students to enter their new home.

Class 1-A arrange their luggage in their respective bedrooms. Later that night, the boys of Class 1-A are in the common space on the first floor. The girls of Class 1-A show up and Mina suggests a room showcasing competition. After checking the boys 'room, it's time to check the girls' room. Kyoka's room is the first of the girls that they visit, much to her displeasure

Her classmates are surprised when seeing the musical theme of her room full of musical instruments, records, and decorative elements that make reference to rock, leading to Denki and Yuga commenting on how it wasn't ladylike at all, leading to Kyoka to attack both of them by inserting her jacks into their ears and vibrating them. Back in the common space on the first floor, she votes Rikido Sato the winner, solely because of his cake.

The following day, Shota tells to Class 1-A that their next goal is to obtain their Provisional Hero Licenses Shota announces that they will be working on developing their own special moves, much to the class' excitement. The class visits the Gym Gamma, where Cementoss creates a training ground for the class with Ectoplasm using his Quirk to create villains for the class to practice their moves on. Kyoka updates her hero costume and adds a set of headphones and two bracelets that double up as her amplifiers.

The day of the License Exam, Class 1-A goes to the place where the tests will take place and here they meet other students from different schools, like Shiketsu High School and Ketsubutsu Academy High School. Later, the organizer of the exam explains to all the participants the rules of the first test, giving all the targets and informs the students that they will have to insert particular balls in the opponents' targets in order to qualify. Those whose targets have been hit by the balls are disqualified. Participants need to eliminate two students to move on to the next phase of the exam.

When the first trial begins, all the opposing students are thrown against the students of the U.A., who find themselves having to defend themselves against a large number of attacks; Kyoka deflects balls coming from the subsoil with her new special move Heartbeat Distortion. However, Yo Shindo from Ketsubutsu Academy uses his Quirk to divides the U.A. students.

After the attack, Kyoka regroups with Tsuyu, Mezo and Momo. In the city area the go to a building with an observatory deck to located more classmates. They do not know that they have fallen into a trap of Saiko Intelli of Seiai Academy.

With no luck, Kyoka uses her Earphone Jacks on the wall and informs them that she hears four people coming. She soon realizes that they aren't stopping on any floor but coming directly towards them. Suddenly, Kyoka gets hit by a high-volume speaker playing music against the wall. The group soon realize it's a coordinated attack. The windows are shattered, Tsuyu and Momo suspect the opponents are waiting for the right time to strike. Kyoka impulsively prepares her super move but is countered and her left ear and arm amp get damaged by an aim Quirk.

Seiai Academy continues their plan by freezing the air conditioner. Kyoka suggest creating an electric heater but Momo says that won't work because the enemy mostly have control of the electricity. Kyoka also suggest creating bomb but Momo says that won't work either due to the unpredictable damage it will cause. Momo comes up with a plan and creates four headphones and a large amp. Everyone puts on the headphones and Kyoka connects her undamaged Earphone Jack and creates a sonic attack. The sound force rattles Kyoka's body but she holds it in.

After a successful counter attack all of the Seiai Academy group is immobilized except Saiko Intelli. Saiko grabs Momo and takes her back to the room Momo had just escaped. Kyoka and the other two come to her aid and save Momo. Saiko questions why they didn't just leave Momo to fail but Kyoka states class 1-A sticks together.

They make it back to the refreshment area, where they met up with Shoto and discover that they're the only ones who have passed so far from their class.
