Once the villains are handed over to the police, Team 3 contacts Team 1 and 2 of 1-A at a police station, who've also apprehended more villains and escapees. Hawks, via the Counter-Force, gives the teams their next assignment: apprehend a Tartarus escapee, Ginji Kurau, who has been spotted nearby.

At the Port of Niigata, Ginji runs away with a woman in his hand. Team 3 arrives on the scene to arrest Ginji and save Anna Scervino, but the villain escapes using his Quirk, Mad Gluttony, to rip through several buildings before they can corner him. Izuku goes on ahead, and the fight leads them to crash into a civilian refugee camp where Izuku tries to restrain Ginji with his Blackwhip, but then suddenly, Ginji becomes more powerful after holding the woman again, allowing him to overwhelm him nearly.

Before Ginji could counter-attack, a man with an eyepatch and cybernetic prosthetics named Giulio Gandini appears and shot at Ginji from a long distance, causing him to let go of the woman. He rides his motorcycle and then loads his prosthetic robot arm to take another shot at Anna, which Izuku is too slow to stop, before Bruno Gollini uses his Delay Spot Quirk to stop the bullet in a time-slowing bubble Ginji. He collects Anna, just before the rest of Team 3 arrives to assist Izuku.

However, they suddenly find themselves confronted with a floating ship carrying the Gollini Family Mafia, consisting of Bruno, Kamile, Deborah, Paulo, Simon, Ugo, Gi, and their leader, Valdo Gollini. He undoes his mask, revealing that he has the appearance of prime All Might, shocking everyone. Anna tries to resist upon being taken onto the ship, but Deborah uses her Quirk, Day Dream, to subdue her.

The members of team 3 wonder what's going on until they realize Ginji has taken advantage of the chaos to run away, causing collateral damage to many buildings, endangering many civilians. Kyoka and the Team break off from engaging Ginji to rescue the civilians who were about to be crushed by debris.

While Team 3 is busy saving the civilians, Valdo comes and brutally defeats Ginji with a powerful Smash similar to All Might’s powers when he had One For All. The shockwave from the attack is so powerful that it knocks people off their feet and causes structural damage in the surrounding area.

Valdo then uses his Quirk to turn several of his coins into cameras and hack every communication network still functioning in the country, with everyone being shocked by his appearance. He announces to the country that he has come to "save Japan" from their despair caused by the war and vows that he will use his strength and power to promote justice and become the next Symbol of Peace in honor of All Might’s god-like powers.

Izuku calls him out with disgust over using violence and putting innocent civilians in danger, taiting All Might's legacy. Hearing his words, Valdo decides to prove Izuku wrong by using his powers. He touches the hypnotized Anna Scervino, and suddenly, his powers tremendously increase as their floating ship transforms into a massive fortress, consuming everything in its path in an ocean of light.

Team 3 tries to flee with as many civilians as they can carry but are helpless after the transformation catches up to them and is consumed as well. Teams 1 and 2, who had just arrived in the area, witnessed the rapid expansion of the transformation. They trys to flee but they, too, are soon caught by the transforming light.

Kyoka and her teammates regain consciousness in a jungle-like environment, but they soon realize that the trees and plants are artificial. Aside from them, there isn't a single one of their classmates or any other civilians present. Kyoka uses her Quirk to locate more people but informs her companions that she hasn't detected anyone besides them. Meanwhile, Mashirao reports that there is no signal. Given the situation, Izuku suggests they should do is confirm the status of the people who were absorbed before escaping from the place, and everyone agrees.

The team tries to leave the forest area, only to come to a dead end. Toru discovers a manhole, so Izuku uses Float, and Ochaco uses her Quirk to lower themselves to investigate. Suddenly, Izuku's Quirk stops working, forcing him to hold on and tell Ochaco to return and inform the others. As soon as she leaves, he loses his grip and falls down the deep hole. On the surface, Ochaco explains to the others what is happening, so Hanta uses his tape so they can go down without needing to use their Quirks.

Kyoka and the team lower themselves into the chute and end up in a snowy mountainous area where Izuku is supposed to be, but they can't see him anywhere. Noticing they can still use their Quirks, they believe Izuku had something to do with it. Before they can move, a hole opens beneath the ground, and the team falls into the hole, leading them to the city center. They come out to see Deborah and Anna with the civilians under Deborah’s Day Dream Quirk. They try to attack, but Deborah uses her Quirk on them, sending them into their dreams.

In her dreams, Kyoka dreamt of herself playing her guitar in a packed concert. While under Deborah’s Quirk, Kyoka touches Anna, but her Overmodification reveals that she is incompatible with her Quirk, and convulses in a painful seizure before losing consciousness.

Later, Izuku and Giulio arrive at the location and also fall to Deborah's Quirk, but they manage to free them from her control, injuring her in the process, waking up the students and the kidnapped citizens. Anna is also freed, but Giulio is about to shoot her, something she seems to accept. However, Izuku intervenes and prevents Giulio from killing Anna. Then Kamile appears and uses his Spatial Excursion quirk to rescue Deborah and take Anna, without the others being able to prevent it.

As students and citizens recover, Giulio finally explains everything about Anna and the Gollini Family. A while ago, he was hired by Anna's father to help with her Overmodification Quirk, which allows her to greatly enhance the Quirk Factors of a few compatible people. However, her quirk became more uncontrollable with the passage of time. Only thanks to his Neutralization Quirk, he could temporarily neutralize her Quirk by touching her with his right arm.

Despite this, Anna's Quirk was becoming more and more powerful and there would come a time when not even his neutralization would be enough to contain it, so Anna made Giulio promise that he would kill her if her Quirk becomes unstable and hurts people. However, the Gollini Family learned of Anna's Quirk, and attacked the household, kidnapping Anna and killing everyone else. Giulio survived, but he had to have parts of his body replaced with robotic prosthetics, and no longer can use his Quirk. He tracked Anna to Japan to fulfill the promise he made to her before is to late.

Kyoka and those from Teams 2 and 3 of 1-A voice their objection that killing Anna will end her suffering, and even if it does, they know that it is not what she and Giulio wanted. They understand that Giulio went through so much to get Anna back, and they will not let her Quirk grow out of control, vowing to save Anna. Team 1 soon appears and also agrees to help Giulio and Anna and defeat Valdo, who now calls himself Dark Might.

After several of his subordinates were defeated by the students, Dark Might orders to change the course of the flying fortress and head directly to the U.A. Shelter. He then broadcasts to the students that he will become the Symbol of Peace when he destroys All Might and the last remnants of the Heroes still at the U.A. Class A organize to prevent this, and while Izuku, Katsuki, Shoto, Fumikage and Giulio head to face the villains, Kyoka and Class A round up the civilians and prepare to evacuate the fortress.

Thanks to her Quirk, Kyoka informs him that she has detected a strong explosion coming from outside the fortress. Assuming it's the heroes trying to assault the Symbol of Paradise, Tenya asks Jiro to guide the civilians toward the explosion. Then Mirio shows up, as he was able to easily infiltrate the fortress with his Permeation, and helps direct everyone towards a better way out.

However, once they leave the town, thousands of monsters conjured by the fortress appear to stop them, so Class 1-A volunteers to cover the civilians and fight the monsters while Mirio and some of the classmates escort the civilians to safety.

The class pushes back, with Kyoka unleashing Heartbeat Distortion to destroy the monsters. However, Class 1-A is starting to lose the battle of attrition against the fortress monsters as every time they destroy them, more monsters keep generating, and on the verge of their defeat, the Heroes from outside manage to get inside the fortress and back them up. While fighting off the monsters, Izuku, Katsuki, Shoto, and Giulio defeat Dark Might, causing the fortress to stop conjuring the monsters, and Mirio defeats Kamille, halting the fortress as it starts falling from the sky.

Although the danger seems to be over, Anna loses control of her Quirk, and Valdo regains consciousness and uses her enhanced properties to turn himself into a colossal monster. Giulio manages to touch Anna, and his own Neutralization Quirk becomes greatly enhanced, allowing him to use it on Anna finally. With Dark Might vulnerable, Izuku, Shoto, and Katsuki defeat him definitively.

With the Gollini Family defeated, the U.A. Shelter is safe, and everyone cheers on the Heroes and Class 1-A for their valiant victory. Tenya and the rest of the class watch as Anna decides to stay with Giulio, now that her Quirk is finally nullified for good.

In preparations for the Final War to defeat All For One and his army of villains, the Heroes plan to utilize Hitoshi Shinso's Brainwashing Quirk to get the Aoyamas to speak to All For One without any malicious intent, allowing the Heroes to lure the villains out to a specific location. They will then further catch the villains off guard by using Neito Monoma copying Kurogiri's Warp Gate Quirk to teleport themselves onto the battlefield.

Kyoka remains with Class 1-A at Troy until Izuku and Yuga successfully lure out All For One and the villains, where they are all teleported onto the battlefield. All Might then activates the "Troy" system trap, encasing the majority of villains into cages, delaying them long enough for them to be pushed into several more Warp Gates by the Heroes and separated.

Kyoka and Fumikage join the team led by Endeavor responsible for dealing with All For One and several miscellaneous villains, ending up at the ruins of the Gunga Mountain Villa, where Hawks is waiting for them. While Endeavor and Hawks deal with All For One himself in the air, Kyoka and the rest of the Heroes remain on the ground to deal with the remaining threats.

In the midst of the battle, All For One manages to catch Endeavor off guard, slicing him with a Quirk Combination attack, and is about to obliterate Hawks with his Air Cannon. Just then, Kyoka, riding Fumikage in his Black Fallen Angel state, uses her Heartbeat Wall to protect Hawks from the attack.

After telling Fumikage to keep still as the two try to adjust to flying through the air, All For One recognizes them as the "gnats around One For All", likening them to the "side characters" in the old comics he read, who existed just to show how strong the Demon Lord was. Kyoka confidently responds back that he should save comments like that until he's actually beaten them.

Hawks tries to warn the students not to interfere due to how dangerous it is, but Fumikage reminds him that they were sent there to help in case things got bad; Hawks reluctantly accepts their help. All For One decides to target the "weakest link" of the group, Kyoka, using a Mouth Quirk to shoot out an array of mouths from his fingertips, until Hawks uses some of his feathers to push her upwards out of the way.

Fumikage manages to catch her, with Dark Shadow asking if she is okay, and Fumikage following up asking her to use her sound waves to try and break All For One's mask. Kyoka suddenly starts to feel incredibly disturbed and tense over the near death experience, realizing just who Izuku and Yuga have been dealing with this whole time.

While attacking Hawks with one hand, All For One uses his other to create a massive Quirk combination cannon aimed directly at the 1-A students. He mocks their anxiousness, asking if they're treating this like just another day at school like "deluded extras", blasting the cannon directly at them, despite Hawks' attempts to use his feathers to push it out of the way, leaving him vulnerable for another attack.

All For One continues to mock Hawks and the students' uselessness, asking the kids if being around the strong made them believe they were worthy of facing down the Demon Lord. Kyoka manages to survive the attack, but her left Earphone Jack was blown away, severely wounding her. Despite the pain, she angrily responds that all he does is talk about who's weak, strong, and special, while she doesn't care at all, only that he made her friends cry.

Fueled by her rage against All For One for hurting her friends, she blasts him with a powerful Ultimate Move, Heartbeat Surround: Legato. All For One attempts to retaliate through the vibrations, but is further resisted by the vestiges of his other Quirks from within, wondering how they were spurred on by the "weakness of pushovers". Hawks is able to take advantage of Kyoka's soundwaves, and thrusting his katana into it, he unleashes a Soundwave Vibration-Enhanced Flight Feather Blade, successfully damaging part of All For One's mask.

Kyoka then jumps off of Fumikage and Dark Shadow, telling them to attack now and catch her later. Fumikage proceeds to unleash a "Ragnarök: Fleeting Blow", creating a giant fist that smashes the rest of All For One's mask, destroying it. He then catches Kyoka, while Hawks mocks All For One for assuming they were just trying to buy some time.

Hawks prepares to go in for the kill, but All For One retaliates, unleashing a hell of Rivet Stabs to attempt to reclaim the broken pieces of his mask. Hawks quickly goes to protect Fumikage and Kyoka from most of the damage, with the three then saved by Endeavor, taking the brunt of the Rivets and losing an arm in the process.

She and Fumikage watched as Endeavor battles All For One, seemingly burning him to a crisp. However, All For One survives using a reverse engineered Quirk-Destroying Drug, rewinding his body back to his prime state, which Fumikage recognizes as being just like Eri's Quirk. Hawks leaves the two students behind as he goes to try and deal with All For One.

Unfortunately, the battle is falling apart when Kurogiri, freed by Spinner, teleports both Dabi from Kamino and Himiko Toga from Okuto Island onto the battlefield. Himiko, who has transformed into Twice, activates and unleashes Sad Man's Parade all over the battlefield, shocking Fumikage and Kyoka. As the Infinite Doubles swarm and Dabi's Blueflames start to overwhelm the Heroes, the two then reunite with Ochaco and Tsuyu after they chased Himiko through the Warp Gate.

Tsuyu notices Kyoka having lost her ear, but she replies she was lucky that was all she lost against the Demon Lord. Ochaco says that all of Japan will be buried unless they stop Himiko, but Fumikage tells them Dabi's flames are too hot, and because there are so many Doubles outnumbering them, all they can do is flee for themselves now that their divide and conquer strategy has failed.

After Fumikage has brought them down to safety, he flies back up in the sky to backup Hawks, while the three try to plan how to deal with the Twice Doubles. Tsuyu theorizes that Himiko hasn't Doubled any of the other Villains due to not being able to use any of their Quirks, since she doesn't "love" them, and because of her unstable emotions, they need to find the original as soon as possible.

Shortly afterward the Heroes receive backup from the Shiketsu High School students to fight off both All For One and the Twice Doubles. Inasa Yoarashi targets most of the Doubles with his Whirlwind Quirk, while the close-ranged attackers deal with the remaining ones, while the long-ranged fighters attack All For One. Taking advantage of the darkness around them, Fumikage unleashes Dark Shadow at its ultimate power, transforming it into a giant monster that pummels All For One into the ground.

As Fumikage continues his assault, Kyoka yells out to the Heroes to cover up Dark Shadow and block out any source of light, with Camie preparing to project an aurora sky with her Quirk to help. Before the Heroes could power up Dark Shadow, All For One unleashes a massive nuclear explosion that blasts away Dark Shadow, greatly diminishing him once again. A now visibly younger All For One attempts to blast his way out of the battlefield, with the Heroes giving chase. The tide seems to change in his favor when Gigantomachia suddenly appears, but instead the beast throws a part of the mountain at his master, as he is being rode by Eijiro and Hitoshi, who is brainwashing him.

While some of the Heroes chase All For One, Kyoka and the rest of the Heroes stay behind to defeat the endless Twice Double swarm that's been rapidly increasing in volume. Thanks to Himiko unleashing, Sad Man's Death Parade, the Heroes become completely consumed by the wave of clones, unable to fight back. During a confrontation with the real Himiko, Ochaco saves Tsuyu before she is stabbed by her knife, pulling her away and just barely grazing her.

Kyoka, carried by Kamui Woods, tries to catch the wounded Tsuyu falling toward her, only for Kamui to reveal he already saved her in his other arm. The Tsuyu falling toward Kyoka suddenly transforms and tries to attack her, only to be smacked away by Kamui. The Heroes realize that the Doubles have started drinking the blood spilled on the battlefield and have begun to transform into the other Heroes, with Kyoka shocked to see evil Doubles of herself. With the never-ending swarm increasing, and now the transforming Doubles stirring confusion amongst the Heroes, they believe there is no way to stop her now.

With rage fueling her insanity, Himiko unleashes Sad Man's Legion, releasing her Doubles to the absolute extreme on a gigantic scale. The swarm becomes an ocean and completely consumes all the Heroes, Villains, and Nomu alike, decimating the nearby city. Kyoka was among those swallowed by the ocean of Doubles as it washes over everything in its path.

However, Ochaco undergoes a Quirk Awakening, allowing her to burst the ocean of Doubles open, causing everyone, including the Heroes, to start floating through the air. Kyoka is surprised to see all this, realizing her Quirk spread to all the bodies that were in contact with each other.

However, Ochaco's Awakening worked too well as it causes other Heroes including herself to float upwards. She uses her right Earphone Jack to jab it into the ground to keep herself from floating up higher while everyone else is kept in the air by the Quirk. Kyoka watches as Ochaco is successfully able to reason with Himiko, getting her to confess to all her feelings and break down, just as the Twice transformation starts to wear off.

She calls out to Ochaco as she sees all the Doubles fade away into the sky. While she was being lifted, Kamui Woods latches onto her to keep her from going up even further. Ochaco proceeds to use her remaining strength to carefully ensure the exhausted and unconscious Heroes have a safe landing.

As Kyoka recovers, Shota had managed to regain control of "Kurogiri" and has begun warping himself all around to gather up all the Heroes that can still fight to provide reinforcements for the final battle. Kyoka, accompanied by most of her fellow 1-A classmates, is warped to Mt. Fuji to help Izuku in his fight against "All For One". Kyoka states that they've already come this far for victory, as all the assembled Heroes together declare "We are here!"

As Izuku runs toward "All For One", the villain unleashed hordes of Quirk attack all over the battlefield, blasting away every Hero who gets in his way, but they all keep countering against his attacks. Shota then calls out to the Heroes through their comms, telling them to help Izuku carve a straight path to Tomura.

In order to help her classmate, Kyoka combines her Earphone Jack's Quirk with Present Mic's directional speaker, allowing his teacher to shout a powerful burst of sound that clears Izuku's path towards "All For One". As Izuku runs towards his target to defeat him, Kyoka cheers for his success.

Eventually, thanks to everyone's efforts, Izuku manages to defeat "All For One" once and for all, just before Tomura's body succumbs to his injuries and dies as his body disintegrates into ashes.

Two weeks after the end of the Final War, the restoration efforts that were stalled after the Jaku Hospital Raid have picked back up at a breakneck pace, as Heroes from around the world arrived to provide support and resources in rescue and rebuilding Japan. A few months later, Kyoka recovers from her injuries after the end of the war and returns to the partially rebuilt U.A.

Months later, it is now June, and the third-year students at U.A. High are finally having their graduation after the end of the Final War. Kyoka attends the U.A. High Graduation along with the rest of her classmates. She watches the Third years receive their diplomas, including Tamaki, Nejire, and Mirio receiving their diplomas. Present Mic, who is MC-ing the event, apologizes for the delayed graduation, and shouts for excitement and the third years enthusiastically join in, while the former second years watching are start to get the jist of it, and the former first years watch speechless.

Mawata Fuwa comes to the stage to give the students a farewell speech. After Mawata Fuwa gives the farewell address as the students' representative, Present Mic calls on the graduates' representative, Mirio. He starts off his speech with a sincere statement thanking everyone for being in attendance, befuddling them all for not starting off with a gag, but reminds everyone they lost so much and gained nothing, and that a Heroes fight is to bring a negative situation back to square one. He concludes that a world without smiles and humor has no bright future, that they seek a positive world where people can live their lives in good cheer, and that is the finish line they're racing toward. He snaps, using his Quirk to blast of into the air, shouting to his underclassmen just as Bibimi Kenranzaki unleashes her giant robot on the cheering crowd.

Later after graduation, Class 1-A has become 2-A and are moved to a temporary classroom. Shota states that they were supposed to be getting a different homeroom teacher, but due to the circumstances, he will be their homeroom teacher for another year, to the students' excitement. Just then, Yuga enters to say his goodbyes since he will be leaving U.A for good, even despite the class' insistence, and both Shota and Naomasa saying he could stay. Yuga says he wants to make matters right, since the only reason he came to the school was because of All For One's orders, and he doesn't believe he deserves a graduation. He vows to atone for his crimes, and will once more walk the path of a hero. He promises that someday he will be worthy of standing beside them all, and reveals another surprise to the class; Hitoshi will be taking his place as Class A's newest member.

As the new semester begins, Class A join up with some Heroes in a city on reconstruction duty, assisting Fat Gum, Suneater, and Best Jeanist in demolishing and repairing a section of buildings. After their first day of semester, Kyoka learns of Ochaco's suffering after the death of Himiko, so she and the rest of Class A head over to the hillside of former Troy to check on her, only to see that Izuku had come before the class. Later, Class A celebrates Yuga's farewell party as Eri starts singing for the class. Kyoka is the lead guitarist for Eri as she starts to do her stellar singing performance for the class.As the months went by, Kyoka would continue working on her school. By the end of the semester, Class A becomes Third Years and focuses on their reconstruction efforts while doing Hero work. Finally, it was time for Class A's graduation ceremony, and all Third Year Students from Class A, B, and Support Course are prepared to have their diplomas ready. Tenya goes on stage to make a speech about their hard work when suddenly Katsuki snaps like Mirio and makes a huge explosion.

Eight years later, Kyoka has graduated and is now a Pro Hero and an accomplished musician. Despite her active focus on both careers, she tends to lean onto the latter, due to feeling her Hero work has grown duller over time. She also became a role model and music tutor for Eri as she attends middle school with the goal of becoming a singer, with Kyoka teaching her how to play bass and guitar on her days off. Meanwhile, Izuku is now a U.A. teacher, and because of him losing One For All, Katsuki came to his former classmates and spearheaded a mechanical suit of armor similar to Armored All Might. The former Class A unanimously agree to lend a hand in building such a advanced tech, that they have to pool a lot of funding from their Hero Work to help making the suit with the aid of Melissa and Mei.

Once the suit was done, All Might will deliver the surprise gift for him. He reveals the data obtained from the battle between him and All For One eight years ago has opened up exciting possibilities, as just as Quirks themselves grow and deepen, so does technology. Izuku figures it must've cost a lot, and he reveals Melissa and Mei came together to create a special armored suit based on the Armored All Might, and the project was funded by the former Class A shocking Izuku. He tells him not to hide it, since his body still has a way of leaping into action, telling him he has also earned this power fair and square; Izuku tears up and smiles. When Hawks mentions traffic being backed up because of a landslide on WarStar Road and requesting Heroes who can respond, Izuku puts on his new "Armored Deku" suit and is joined by his former classmates, including Kyoka, to head towards the landslide.

At a restaurant, the former students of Class A celebrate Shoto's new Number 2 Hero ranking on the Hero Billboard Chart JP. The classmates discuss amongst themselves the differing nature of the hero rankings nowadays, and joking around about each other's placements and their current statues as Heroes and Sidekicks. Rikido mentions his surprise everyone has been able to get together once again, which Mashirao states is due to the decreasing number of Villains every year. Fumikage remarks on the Heroes both old and new that have continued fighting all this time, thinking that eventually Heroes are headed towards extinction. Toru then reveals that Shihai and Kinoko are now dating, leading Hanta to ask about Denki and Kyoka as a pair, since their Hero Agencies are right next to each other. They both laugh it off as Denki simply moving into the available building next door. Suddenly, everyone receives a notification of a criminal's Quirk causing alot of damage, as the former classmates blast off together.

The incident is quickly resolved, as the criminal is arrested, noting that it was just a "sudden impulse". The group decide to split up for the night, with all of them going their separate ways.
